It sounds like you’ve found a way to make your morning routine meaningful and intentional. If you enjoy it, there’s no reason not to continue—it’s a personal practice that can enhance your sense of readiness and self-assurance. Plus, it’s always a good idea to take care of yourself in ways that feel good to you!
